report.value: BQ40Z80RSMR for Pack overcurrent protection, Bench pack balance lead and Pack temperature, the part R5 selected for the pack disconnect in FU-2B1. R5's P2 in FU-2F chooses the disconnect on its own; a different choice there is a conflict for the owner (V297, V298)
report.source: selection.json R5 pack disconnect; this return

report.value: 52.1 A nominal at a 5.8 V bus with the pack path sized at 6.0 V (V294); IOBoard.md's about 49.7 A is the older figure. Both rest on an assumed 90 % efficiency; V140 reads about 88.5 % typical, no guaranteed figure. P5 recomputes it
report.source: V294 answer; IOBoard.md Pack path current; V140 (found)

report.figure: pack discharge rating against the current
report.value: 90 A continuous (30C): 1.73 times 52.1 A and 1.29 times the 69.7 A upper overcurrent edge; 180 A burst (60C, duration not stated): 1.80 times the 100.2 A upper short-circuit edge

BQ40Z80 AOLD 0x08, 61.08 mV, 1 mOhm shunt: nominal 61.1 A; 52.5 to 69.7 A with the datasheet's no-trim +-10 % and +-2.5 mV, 55.5 to 66.6 A post-trim (+-5 %). The datasheet does not say which applies to a shipped part. The lower edge is 0.4 A above 52.1 A before the shunt's tolerance: a shunt 0.7 % low brings it under 52.1 A on the no-trim figures. Delay 1 to 31 ms plus 160 us detect
report.source: SLUSBV4D 5.5; SLUUBT5C Appendix A OLD Threshold (RSNS = 1)

report.value: SCD1 88.8 mV at 1 mOhm: 77.4 to 100.2 A (no trim), 81.9 to 95.7 A (post-trim), delay 0 to 915 us (1850 us with SCDDx2)

The BQ40Z80 datasheet states no cell-voltage accuracy. Without board calibration: K 0.198 to 0.202 (33 mV at 3.3 V), ADC gain error 0.8 % of full scale (49 mV at the cell if full scale is 1.225 V, 98 mV if 2.45 V), offset 0.8 mV: 83 to 132 mV. CUV:Threshold 3390 to 3440 mV holds the 3.3 V lowest trip. The same band puts a 4.25 V COV as low as 4.12 to 4.17 V, under the 4.2 V full charge, so per-board voltage calibration, which the datasheet requires before gauging, is needed for COV. Calibrated accuracy is not stated
report.source: SLUSBV4D 5.5 ADC and K rows, 7.3.1; computed

report.value: CUV:Delay is set in whole seconds (0 to 255 s, default 2 s). A sag below 3.3 V shorter than the delay is not stopped, against the maker's 'auch nicht kurzzeitig' (not even briefly)

TS pull-up 14.4 to 21.6 kOhm (+-20 %), not stated as trimmed. With a 10 kOhm, B 3435 K NTC that is +-4.0 K at 0 °C, +-4.5 K at 18 °C and +-5.7 K at 55 °C before calibration (computed); a one-point temperature offset calibration at 25 °C leaves about 1 K at 0 and 55 °C (computed)
report.source: SLUSBV4D 5.5 RNTC(PU); computed from B 3435 K

report.figure: stage 2 MOSFETs: protector CHG and DSG
report.value: High-side back-to-back N-channel. Drain-source: at least the pack's 8.45 V and the pack input clamp level, 37.3 V for TVS2701DRBR at 125 °C (Follows-ups row of R5); a 40 V class covers both. Current: 52.1 A continuous, up to 69.7 A for the overcurrent delay (31 ms) and 100.2 A for the short-circuit delay (915 us). Gate drive 10.5 to 12.5 V (VFETON). Body diode: the CHG FET's diode carries discharge current until the gauge turns the FET on (SLUUBT5C 12.1), the DSG FET's diode up to 2.15 A of charge current. Share of the drop allowance: P5's
report.source: SLUSBV4D 5.5; SLUUBT5C 12.1; Research.md Follow-ups (input transient clamp row)

report.figure: stage 2 MOSFETs: charger BATFET and switches
report.value: BQ25723: one P-channel BATFET carries the pack current, 52.1 A continuous and 69.7 A briefly, driven 10 V below VSYS but limited by VSYS of 5.8 to 6.6 V at the floor, Ciss under 5 nF advised; drain-source at least the 12 V 2S SYSOVP. Whether one such P-channel FET carries 52.1 A at a 6 V gate drive is not known. Four N-channel switching FETs: input side at least VBUS 5.5 V, output side at least 12 V, about 3 A

report.figure: charger battery path loss and drop
report.value: The 5 mOhm RSR is in the pack-to-load path: 0.261 V and 13.6 W at 52.1 A, 0.349 V at 69.7 A, 0.501 V at the 100.2 A short-circuit edge, over the 0.5 V SRP-SRN absolute maximum for up to 1 ms. With the 1 mOhm protector shunt the two resistors drop 0.313 V at 52.1 A, more than the 0.2 V from a 6.0 V pack to the 5.8 V bus of V294 and within the 0.8 V from the 6.6 V floor. LTC4020 at 4 mOhm: 0.208 V, 10.9 W; 0.401 V at 100.2 A against its 0.3 V CSP-CSN maximum
94.7 % typical from 5 V into 7.4 V (V139). 1.69 A into 8.4 V and 2.15 A into 6.6 V from 15 W; 0.56C to 0.72C

report.figure: charge voltage against the maker's 4.2 V
report.value: BQ25723 at 8.4 V: 8.3496 to 8.4504 V (+-0.6 %, 0 to 85 °C), 4.2252 V a cell at the upper edge, 25 mV over the maker's 'nicht überschreiten'. A setting of 8.352 V keeps the edge at 8.402 V if the +-0.6 % holds there; the datasheet tabulates it at 8.4 V and 4.2 V only
report.source: SLUSE64 8.5 VBAT_REG_ACC; SLS safety notes sections 1 and 3

report.value: Required 84.6 mA average a cell (V142). BQ29209/BQ29200 external mode: Ibal = VCELL / RCB_EXT, 44.9 Ohm or less gives 84.6 mA at 3.8 V. BQ40Z80 internal 10 mA; MAX17320 about 62 mA average; BQ76907 50 mA

report.figure: pack run time at the nominal draw
report.value: about 3.5 min from full at 52.1 A (3.0 Ah / 52.1 A), 2.8 min at the maker's 80 % use; no discharge curve published, so no rate derating
V296's 15 A below 18 °C is 5C on 3.0 Ah, the maker's limit for loads without preheating; near 10 °C the maker's limit is under 15C (45 A). The maker states no rate between 0 and 10 °C
BQ40Z80 SMBus 0x16 8-bit (0x0B 7-bit), 100 kHz, XL 400 kHz, inputs to 32 V; BQ25723 I2C 0x6B; FUSB303B 0x21 or 0x31 (ADDR/ORIENT)
report.source: SLUUBT5C SMBus Address; SLUSE64 9.5; IOBoard.md Not known

report.value: BQ40Z80 ships configured for 6S: the first power-up on a 2S pack needs a supply on PACK+ until the cell configuration is written, then a data-flash image (cell count, thresholds, Scale Factor 2 for currents above 32,767 mA, thermistor polynomial, FET Options[OTFET] = 1, CUV_RECOV_CHG = 1) and a calibration per board. Shutdown current 1.4 uA typical, no maximum stated, against V301's 10 uA
